description: Source code for PPP options handling in Zephyr OS network subsystem, including parsing, configuration, and option management functions.

methods.name: ppp_parse_options
methods.description: Parses PPP options from a network packet, calling a provided parse callback for each option.

methods.name: ppp_peer_option_info_get
methods.description: Retrieves peer option info by code from a list of options.

methods.name: ppp_config_info_req
methods.description: Handles PPP configuration info request, parsing options and generating appropriate responses.

methods.name: ppp_my_options_add
methods.description: Creates a packet with the local PPP options to send.

methods.name: ppp_my_option_get
methods.description: Retrieves local PPP option info and data by code.

methods.name: ppp_my_option_parse
methods.description: Parses a specific PPP option from a packet using a handler.

methods.name: ppp_my_options_parse
methods.description: Parses multiple PPP options from a packet with a specified handler.

methods.name: ppp_my_option_parse_conf_ack
methods.description: Handles parsing of PPP options in a configuration acknowledgment.

methods.name: ppp_my_options_parse_conf_ack
methods.description: Parses PPP options in a configuration acknowledgment packet.

methods.name: ppp_my_option_parse_conf_nak
methods.description: Handles parsing of PPP options in a configuration NAK.

methods.name: ppp_my_options_parse_conf_nak
methods.description: Parses PPP options in a configuration NAK packet.

methods.name: ppp_my_option_parse_conf_rej
methods.description: Handles parsing of PPP options in a configuration reject.

methods.name: ppp_my_options_parse_conf_rej
methods.description: Parses PPP options in a configuration reject packet.

methods.name: ppp_my_option_flags
methods.description: Returns flags for a specific PPP option code.
